Subject: Next steps & network/air-gap details — CedarCare Private Deployment

Hi Albert — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed set of next steps so we can line up the technical deep-dive with your network team.

Top pain points you shared
- Data residency and regulatory constraint: logs and PHI must remain on-prem and be purged per retention schedule.
- Air-gapped / limited egress: no general internet egress from the inference cluster; only approved outbound endpoints during maintenance windows.
- Long change windows and strict change control: any software install needs formal CAB approval and a defined rollback plan.
- Performance predictability: 99th percentile latency targets for charting/triage workloads.

Goals we agreed on
- Private deployment inside CedarCare VPC or fully air-gapped on-prem appliance depending on security signoff.
- Integration with your KMS/HSM for key management and customer-controlled encryption at rest.
- A technical deep-dive with your networkops + our solutions engineer to validate firewall rules, NAT/peering options, and data flows.

Immediate asks from our side
1) Can you share a network diagram (VLANs, firewalls, egress proxies) and the document your security team uses for third-party deployments?
2) Confirm whether outbound access to a few specific Redwood endpoints (for metrics and optional model pulls) is permitted, or whether you need a fully offline install.
3) Preferred windows for a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive (we suggested 2026-07-15 morning PT below).

Attachments: redwood-private-networking-checklist.pdf (network port list, cert instructions, sample ACLs).

Proposed next steps
- Send the checklist and an offline install brief (attached).
- Schedule the deep-dive with networkops and procurement to discuss lead times and procurement requirements.
- If air-gapped install is required, we’ll provide an offline bundle and a runbook for CAB.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once I have your availability and the network diagram.

— Sergio Alvarez

Sergio — thanks for the clear recap. This matches our notes from today.

Clarifications from our side:
- We do need data to stay in-region and have strict controls on PHI. Any persistent logs or metrics that could contain identifiers must be configurable to stay on-prem.
- For initial evaluation we can allow outbound to a tightly controlled set of endpoints (we'll validate the FQDN/IPs), but production must support an air-gapped option.
- KMS: we use an HSM-backed KMS (Thales). We'll need to understand certificate exchange and key rotation procedures.

I've attached our internal network requirements doc (cedarcare-internal-network-requirements.docx) and looped in networkops and procurement to this thread. They'll review and propose time slots for the technical meeting.

Can you also send an estimated lead time for an air-gapped delivery and a ballpark professional services estimate for the initial integration? Procurement will need those figures to start the internal approval.

Thanks,
Albert

Hi Albert — Monica from Solutions Engineering here. Appreciate the details — adding some technical context so networkops has a starting checklist.

High-level network/ops notes (for the deep-dive):
- Preferred: VPC-deployed private endpoint model (peered VPC with restricted routing). Typical ports: 443 (TLS) outbound to allow model pulls/metrics; 22 only for controlled support windows (jumpbox).
- Air-gapped option: we provide an "offline bundle" (container images + model artifacts + install playbook). Requires the following from your infra team: an appliance host with 1 Gbps NIC, 2 TB free for model artifacts (depending on model family), and an approved SAN for persistent KV cache.
- KMS/HSM: we support PKCS#11-backed HSM integration and can do offline key exchange. Need to confirm Thales model for exact steps.
- Metrics & telemetry: we can limit telemetry to an internal push to a customer-hosted metrics endpoint; nothing leaves your network unless explicitly allowed.

Attachments: private-deploy-offline-instructions.txt (offline bundle checklist and CAB runbook).

Available slots for a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive (PT):
- Thu 2026-07-15 09:00–10:30
- Thu 2026-07-15 13:00–14:30
- Fri 2026-07-16 10:00–11:30

I've also created a tentative calendar link for the meeting: https://cal.com/redwood/tech-deep-dive-cedarcare — pick a slot and I'll send the invite.

Quick note on timelines: an air-gapped delivery (offline bundle + on-site install by our services team) is typically 4–6 weeks from signed SOW, assuming hardware is provisioned. Ballpark PS estimate: $45k–90k depending on scope (integration, CAB support, onsite). We can tighten after the deep-dive.

Happy to join the technical call and cover install/runbook details.

— Monica Patel
